requirement.statement: Halfcode contract layer SHALL expose serializable RuntimeInstance contract types for src/create/prototype/derive based runtime objects.

case.given: A RuntimeInstanceSpec is authored for a runtime object.
case.then: The system SHALL require exactly one source family among src, create, or prototype.
The system SHALL allow an optional derive entry without declaring runtime internals in XNL.

requirement.statement: Halfcode contract layer SHALL expose a RuntimeScopeAssembly contract that carries scope config and sibling bindings into runtime code.

case.given: A Scope contains effect, data graph, intent, config, and runtime bindings.
case.when: The loader projects that Scope for runtime assembly.
case.then: The projected assembly SHALL remain serializable data and SHALL NOT execute code.

requirement.statement: The unit contract scheme table SHALL include canonical halfcode domains for runtime, effect, config, and data graph families.

case.given: The support loader reads the contract scheme table.
case.then: The table SHALL contain config, effect.types, data.graph, data.graph.logic.types, data.graph.seed, and runtime.
